title: The bridge over the bay
logline: The Yaquina bridge from the bus's window at dawn, the arches going past one by one, the page drawing four of them and the fifth cut by the frame. The one thing on the route he has driven; drawn as if he hadn't.

panels.composition: A bus window from inside passing over a tall arched bridge at dawn, four green arches going past and a fifth cut by the frame's edge, gray water below.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bus window from inside passing over a tall arched bridge at dawn with four arches going past and a fifth cut by the frame's edge, gray water below, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
